explanation: Let the angles be x,y,z>0 with x+y+z=π. Applying Lagrange multipliers to ln(sin x sin y sin z) gives cot x=cot y=cot z. Since cotangent is strictly decreasing on (0,π), all angles equal π/3. The product is then (√3/2)³=3√3/8. On the boundary of the closed angle domain the product is zero, so this interior candidate is the global maximum.
